author: Patrick Cc:
description:
Banksy warned us about power, surveillance, and greed destroying our society. And then his own art became a product of all three. What started as free street art turned into multimillion-dollar assets owned by the elite. This is the story of how Banksy's warnings were ignored because people were distracted by how much money his warnings were worth.
